error[ZC-E0819]: a certificate is of another kind than this use needs
  cause  node2's certificate is a workload certificate; this use needs a server
         certificate
  fix    give the peer a certificate issued for its role (docs/mtls.md)
  more   zcube explain E0819 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0819.html
